verdict.rationale: Honeybadger auto-resolves unresolved errors when a deployment is recorded and links errors to deploys, and Slack error messages carry resolve/reopen controls. That is the lifecycle a regression alert would depend on, and `occurred.after:'last deploy'` lets you scope errors to the newest release. However, no evidence says a resolved error that recurs after a deploy is reopened and sent as an alert distinct from new-error notifications. missing for 10: documented reopen-on-recurrence (regression) behavior, a regression-specific notification separate from new-issue alerts, release/version tagging of the regression, independent or hands-on corroboration.
